meta.note: x = world X (east), y = world north/Z, meters. The level's HM2 block only covers the ~2 km battle tile, so the whole level was rebuilt from the lmap LandMesh triangle mesh (TIN); that mesh spans the level's real extent. Reconstruction matches HM2 with a median absolute error of 0.14 m on the levels that carry both. Row 0 of the heightmap is at originY. Inside meta.detail.bounds the contours come from HM2 at 5 m interval (contoursDetail); outside it from the lmap TIN.

detail.note: Battle tile re-traced from the level's own HM2 block at 2 m/px; the lmap layer stops at the tile edge (blanked, so the seam is quantised to one coarse cell ~64.0313 m).

airfields.note: runway centrelines in replay-world-meters; headingDeg is the ends[0]->ends[1] bearing, take-off runs takeoffHeadingDeg; altM is absolute altitude, not height above ground
